title: Power BI Premium Capacity Overload
dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.
app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log; Power BI REST Admin API and on-prem data gateway logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:capacity:metrics metric=cpu_percentage
| bin _time span=5m
| stats max(value) as max_cpu by capacityName, _time
| where max_cpu>90
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Premium (or PPU/Fabric) capacity CPU utilisation and flags sustained overload that triggers throttling and slows reports for everyone on the capacity.
value: When a Premium capacity is overloaded it throttles interactive and refresh operations for all workspaces on it; early detection avoids fleet-wide slowdowns.
implementation: Ingest capacity metrics (Fabric Capacity Metrics app export or API) via HEC; schedule every 5 minutes; alert on sustained high CPU. Rebalance workspaces or scale the SKU.
visualization: Timechart of capacity CPU, single-value overload indicator, alert.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities (audit log)

grandmaExplanation: We watch how hard your shared Power BI engine is working so you know when it is overloaded and slowing everyone's reports down.
